lines.text: Jesus takes the Twelve aside and says the Son of Man will be delivered over to the Gentiles.
Jesus says they will flog Him and kill Him, and on the third day He will rise again.
Near Capernaum, a blind man sits begging beside the road and hears Jesus of Nazareth is passing by.
He calls Jesus Son of Abraham and asks for mercy, and those leading the way tell him to be silent.
Jesus stops and has the man brought to Him, and the man receives his sight and follows Jesus, glorifying God.
